# Blue jute

Type: Material | Internal ID: JuteBlue | Source: Mistlands | Usage: Building | Teleportable (Can go through wood portal?): Yes

# Introduction

Blue jute is a material. It is obtained by destroying the curtains and drapes which adorn Dvergr-made Black marble structures in the Mistlands.

### Building

• Blue jute carpet
• Blue jute curtain
• Blue jute drapes
